title: Interview MAGWOC-8 on South Korean financial system
descriptions: MAGWOC-8 is an academic which has participated in several governmental commissions on financial reforms. MAGWOC-8 provides insights on the political economy of financial reforms in Korea. We discuss the reforms after the Korean financial crisis (1997), developments in the financial sector and financial supervision since then, and Korea’s position in international policymaking processes.
